metadata.article_title: Distribution of property among heirs in class II of the Schedule.

article.title: Distribution of property among heirs in class II of the Schedule.
article.content: The property of an intestate shall be divided between the heirs specified in any one entry in class II of the Schedule so that they, share equally.
article.html:
11Distribution of property among heirs in class II of the Schedule.

Section 11 · Chapter II · General · page 9 of the Act

The property of an intestate shall be divided between the heirs specified in any one entry in class II of the Schedule so that they, share equally.
